thesis: Strategy v1 (2026-11-11): HOLD the independent crypto paper account in cash and reassess after the next completed Coinbase UTC daily bar, with a multiweek horizon for any eventual position. At the repository collector's 2026-11-17 22:06:40 UTC update, crypto state shows $1,000 cash, no positions, no pending orders, and 11 processed HOLD decisions through November 16; there is nothing to SELL and no conflicting order. The latest completed BTC/USD Coinbase candle is November 16, close $64,816.79 (not a live November 17 executable quote), versus its 20-day SMA $74,262.70, approximately 12.72% below; the SMA has fallen from $77,705.29 five days earlier and BTC's completed five-day return is -12.32%. The passive BTC benchmark's November 16 matched mark is $853.20 versus $1,000 portfolio equity; this $146.80 difference results from 100% cash exposure during a declining BTC market, not a proven trading signal. ETH $1,819.02, SOL $71.51, ADA $0.153 and LINK $9.133 are also November 16 completed closes; no independently established distinct catalyst justifies preferring an altcoin to BTC after costs. CoinDesk's November 17 06:36 EST report quotes BTC near $64,200 and says the seven-day US spot BTC ETF outflow streak ended with a small $7.9 million Monday inflow (attributed to Farside); that is a timestamped intraday report, not a completed Coinbase bar, and reported ETF flows are off-chain fund data rather than verified on-chain signals. Reuters November 17 describes wider risk-off pressure and uncertain interest-rate outlook. One modest positive ETF-flow day does not offset a sharply declining completed-price trend. The next entry review will look for a completed BTC close back above a stabilizing 20-day average with improving five-day momentum, or several completed days of sustained stabilization with corroborated demand and acceptable costs. A 5–15% initial BTC paper position could then be justified without claiming a proven predictive edge; waiting risks missing a rebound. No strategy change is warranted on this evidence.
risk_notes: No open crypto positions, pending orders or fills; cash exposure is 100%. HOLD incurs no transaction cost. A future buy of at least $10 and at most 35% of portfolio equity per asset must account for modeled 0.10% fee plus 0.05% adverse slippage per fill (about 0.30% round-trip if both sides fill). Intraday quotes and ETF-flow estimates can be stale or revised; macro explanations and market-maker forecasts are uncertain and not independently validated on-chain. The primary HOLD risk is missing a sharp BTC rebound; downside risk of entry includes continuing trend losses, liquidity stress and gap moves. The collector alone can accept a prospective instruction and simulate a later eligible fill; no real-money trading, leverage, derivatives, shorts, cross-portfolio transfers or stock actions.
